visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Counter stuck at 1
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The counter shows 1 after the first click, and then never goes higher. The count is reset to zero every time the button is clicked.
visualizerParams.buggyCode: 0

solution.code: 0
solution.explanation: A variable declared inside the handler is created again on every click, so it always starts from 0. Declare the counter outside the function so it keeps its value between clicks.
